title: Decision records version 2
decision: Accept the decision records in docs/07-adr/OUTPUT.md version 2: ADR-002 to ADR-007 and ADR-010 kept or amended, ADR-001, ADR-008 and ADR-009 superseded, and ADR-011 to ADR-021 new
context: Rewritten for PRD version 2 after the change of direction (DEC-012, DEC-013). By founder instruction the agent decided open points without stopping; the founder reviews all six documents at the end.
rationale: Formalizes the version 2 architecture; ADR-019 follows the founder decision on card-transfer payments, whose lawfulness is unverified (EVID-035) and which may conflict with Telegram payment rules (EVID-028)
